canonical_codec.rational_form: coprime nonnegative numerator and positive denominator

universal_machine.input_register_rule: inputs occupy the initial registers in signature order
universal_machine.noninput_register_initialization: typed zero: bit=0, nat=0, bytes=empty, rational=0/1, json=null
universal_machine.cost_model: bit-cost: one dispatch plus bits read, written, and allocated; bounded_halts additionally charges every canonical U_TM_v1 step
universal_machine.universal_basis: two unbounded natural registers, add/subtract, equality, branch, and jump form a Minsky-complete core
universal_machine.machine_numbering: U_TM_v1: natural index interpreted as minimal big-endian bytes containing the A3+ULEB128 transition-table format; invalid codes halt at step zero
universal_machine.bit_order: get_bit index zero is the least-significant bit of the final byte
universal_machine.nat_encoding: minimal unsigned big-endian bytes; zero is the empty byte string

membership_semantics.uniformity: one finite kind=ir WV-IR program per protocol role for every scale n
membership_semantics.gap: there exist rational c>0 and N such that completeness minus soundness is at least c for every n>=N
membership_semantics.resource_bound: there exist integers C,k,N with each weak-verifier resource at most C*ceil(log2(T(n)+2))^k for every n>=N
membership_semantics.honest_bound: honest role execution uses at most T(n) gas
membership_semantics.adversary_bound: quantify over every role strategy using at most T(n) gas
membership_semantics.noise_bound: quantify over every rational transition kernel accepted by noise_legal after every history
membership_semantics.fault_semantics: honest or verifier FAULT loses completeness; adversary FAULT or malformed output receives the frozen malformed payoff
membership_semantics.FIX: the named fixed_interface is quantified before protocol programs
membership_semantics.ADM: a uniform protocol package selects an interface from admissible_interfaces before the hidden world and execution coins

claim_boundary: This grammar is a nonnormative successor proposal. Adopting it creates ASMP-3-MACHINE-v0.3 and does not silently amend ASMP-CANDIDATE-SET-v0.1.
